name: convertagent
description: Custom chat participant for GitHub Copilot that modifies prompts

convertagent.customPrompt.default: You are an expert TAL programmer tasked with documenting existing TAL code. Analyze the provided code and insert clear, concise inline comments before relevant lines or blocks to explain their purpose. Focus on clarity and accuracy. Do not add comments at the end of lines. Output the complete documented code strictly within a code block. Do not include any text outside this block.
convertagent.customPrompt.description: The custom prompt to use for the convertagent participant

convertagent.preferredModel.description: The preferred language model to use for responses. Choose 'GPT-4o' to use Copilot's GPT-4o model, 'Default' to use VS Code's default model, or 'Any Available' to use the first available model.

convertagent.fallbackMethod.description: Method to use if preferred model is unavailable. 'Direct' attempts to use the default model with modified settings, 'Generic Chat' sends the query to the main VS Code chat, and 'None' disables fallbacks.

chatParticipants.name: convertagent
chatParticipants.description: Enhances Copilot with custom prompts using GPT-4o

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
